provider.ovh-zimbra.note: Login: the full address and the password of the Zimbra mailbox. Starter plan with IMAP/SMTP.
provider.ovh-mxplan.note: Login: the full address. Official aliases: imap.mail.ovh.net and smtp.mail.ovh.net.
provider.ovh-emailpro.note: Replace pro1 with the server number shown in the customer area (pro?.mail.ovh.net).
provider.ovh-exchange.note: Replace ex5 with the server shown in the customer area (ex?.mail.ovh.net); IMAP must be enabled on the account.
provider.google.note: An app password is required (2-step verification enabled), not the account password.
provider.microsoft.note: Microsoft is retiring password authentication (IMAP and SMTP AUTH) in favor of OAuth 2, not yet supported here: it only works if the administrator left SMTP AUTH enabled.
provider.orange.note: Login: the full @orange.fr address; password of the Orange mailbox.
